summary: Frontend-only full-cycle regression passed. Verified 221 exact green LEDs with active idle shimmer, hard digital green-to-amber flip, static opacities throughout the active sequence, ignored extra taps, exactly-once performAction at red start, 10s red hold behavior, return to green at 15.58s, shimmer resumption, and successful second activation. Desktop and mobile layouts passed; no blocking console errors occurred.

ui_bugs.issue: Known non-blocking development-console error remains: React rejects the generated non-boolean SVG DOM attribute collapsable=false. Animation and interactions are unaffected.

action_items: Optional cleanup: filter or avoid the generated collapsable=false attribute on animated SVG polygons to keep the development console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code-review defects found. ACTIVE_SPEED_PRESET resolves to NORMAL=500ms, shimmer is only attached during IDLE_GREEN, the running/disabled guards prevent overlapping sequences, and performAction is invoked only in the RED_ACTIVE transition callback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested runtime behaviors passed; one known non-blocking development warning remains

context_for_next_testing_agent: Used the explicitly requested http://localhost:3000 because this Expo-only app has no frontend .env or backend. Full cycle: 221/221 exact green initially; 154/221 sampled opacities changed over 1.5s; at a mid-flip snapshot there were 64 green, 157 amber, and 0 blended polygons; all 221 settled amber; opacities were identical across sequence samples; all 221 were red at RED_ACTIVE; performAction logged once despite seven extra pointer taps; Ready returned at 15.577s with 221 green; 154/221 opacities changed after 1.2s, proving shimmer resumed. Second activation reached red and increased the action-log total from one to exactly two. Mobile control was centered at 346x346 and settled amber correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional failure reproduced. The only observed console issue is the previously known React development warning: react-native-web Animated supplies collapsable=false to the animated react-native-svg Polygon, which reaches the SVG DOM as an invalid non-boolean attribute. It is non-blocking and unrelated to sequence or shimmer behavior.
